Backend API-level validated the full confirm/paid transitions.
critical_code_review_comments: tr_compliance._build_one: uses `force=True` default parameter and *also* checks for existing tr_invoice_uuid — the force check is inverted (blocks only when force=False, but the public /build endpoint calls without passing force, keeping force=True default which bypasses the duplicate guard). Duplicate invoices from consecutive /build calls are technically possible on same booking; only unique-per-booking guarantee is the last-write on booking.tr_invoice_uuid. Consider tightening.

tr_compliance.efatura_bulk: `check_out: {'$gte': month-01, '$lte': month-31}` will miss check_out on the actual last day of a 30-day month if compared as strings? Actually YYYY-MM-31 compares OK lexicographically so no bug — but months like Feb would over-scan into March-01. Not incorrect but non-idiomatic.

be_conversion.add_upsell: `upsell_unpaid_total` on the already-added branch (line 232) sums unpaid items excluding the newly added one; but on new-add branch (line 243) it adds the new price. Consistent — good.
be_payments.upsell_intent: does not clamp `amount<=0` distinct from missing booking (raises 400 'Ödenecek ekstra yok') — behavior correct.
site_builder._approved_translations: only keeps keys explicitly in `approved` dict. If translation.faqs exists but approved.faqs missing, faqs never leak — good default-deny.
site_builder.save_site rebuilds `approved` dict only for keys with non-empty translation values — so approved.headline gets dropped if headline empty. Consistent with UI badge count.
site_builder.campaign_stats: `status='active'` requires published AND in_window AND promo.is_active — matches promo_codes flag flow correctly.
